turns.question: At which hour of the day were the most page views recorded between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many page views were in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hour-of-day breakdown (its finest grain is the day), so I can't say which hour had the most page views between 20 September and 3 October 2026. The closest metrics are site_sessions (sessions with a page view) and customer_actions filtered to the page_view action type, both available per day.
